purpose: Exhaustive catalog of canonical v2 migration targets. Reviewed first-class concepts carry strict contracts; migrated-only leaves remain explicitly provisional until leaf-level concept review.

review_policy.reviewed: Definition, kind, cardinality, temporality, sensitivity, storage and value contract reviewed.
review_policy.provisional_migrated: Canonical semantic home accepted through migration review; leaf-level kind/value details may be refined without moving the semantic home unless a major ontology review approves it.
